title: Save Contacts
prompt: contacts is given (a dict of name -> phone). Save it as JSON into contacts.json with ensure_ascii=False and indent=2. The test loads the file back and compares.

tests.name: file round-trips
tests.code:
import json as _j
with open("contacts.json", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _d = _j.load(_f)
assert _d == {"Minh": "0901", "Lan": "0902"}, f"got {_d}"
assert "json.dump" in code, "use json.dump into the open file"
tests.hint: with open("contacts.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(contacts, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
